'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Bombing of Kherson (2022–present)|Bombing of Kherson]]
****Eight [[civilian]]s are injured in [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] strikes on the [[St. Catherine's Cathedral, Kherson|St. Catherine's Cathedral]] in [[Kherson]]. News)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***Clashes in [[Sirba, West Darfur|Sirba]], [[West Darfur]], [[Sudan]], cause at least 460 deaths and more than 1,000 injuries, with the [[Rapid Support Forces]] seizing the city. [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/army-accused-of-allowing-violence-to-engulf-sirba-in-west-darfur (Dabanga Sudan)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[Colombia]] and the [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|National Liberation Army]] begin a six-month [[ceasefire]] aimed at creating peace between both sides. [https://apnews.com/article/colombia-eln-guerrilla-peace-agreement-cease-fire-0a35f7f2e0e9b0818c8a2cd4b02ee3ff (AP)]
*[[War in Amhara]]
**[[Ethiopian National Defence Forces|Ethiopian soldiers]] clash with ethnic [[Amhara people|Amhara]] [[Fano (militia)|Fano]] [[militia]]men in several areas across the [[Amhara Region]], with Fano seizing several airports and major cities. [https://apnews.com/article/ethiopia-military-amhara-violence-c487bd66bc4042bd23bb7122f05dafa0 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Saudi Arabia]], the world's [[List of countries by oil exports|largest oil exporter]], extends their voluntary [[Energy in Saudi Arabia|oil production]] cut of one million barrels per day for another month, maintaining daily production at approximately nine million barrels. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/middle-east/20230803-saudi-extends-1m-bpd-oil-output-cut-energy-ministry (AFP via RFI)]
*[[South Korea|South Korean]] automakers [[Hyundai Motor Company|Hyundai]] and [[Kia]] announce that they have recalled over 113,000 vehicles in the [[United States]] due to the risk of fire. [https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-transportation/hyundai-kia-recall-91000-us-vehicles-over-fire-risks-urge-owners-park-outside-2023-08-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*In [[Mexico]], at least 18 people are killed and 23 others are injured when a bus traveling from [[Mexico City]] to [[Tijuana]], [[Baja California]], falls into a [[ravine]] in [[Tepic]], [[Nayarit]]. The driver is arrested for suspected [[overspeed]]ing. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2023/08/04/mexican-bus-carrying-migrants-crashes-killing-18_6079532_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')]
*Nine days after catching fire off the coast of the [[Netherlands]], the [[car carrier]] MV ''[[MV Fremantle Highway|Fremantle Highway]]'' is successfully towed to the port of [[Eemshaven]]. [https://www.ad.nl/binnenland/uitgebrand-vrachtschip-afgemeerd-in-julianahaven-waddenzee-ontsnapt-aan-grote-milieuramp~aa71cdb41/ (AD)]
*The [[Kyrgyzstan]] [[Ministry of Emergency Situations (Kyrgyzstan)|Emergency Situations Ministry]] declares an emergency in the [[Tüp District]] due to [[flood]]ing. [https://m.akipress.com/news:723717:Emergency_situation_regime_declared_in_two_villages_of_Tyup_district/ (AKIPress)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The [[European Union]] extends sanctions against [[Belarus]] over [[Belarusian involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine|their support]] of [[Russian invasion of Ukraine|Russia's invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.rferl.org/amp/belarus-eu-sanctions-russia/32532976.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[2023 Nigerien coup d'état]]
**[[Senegal]] pledges to contribute [[Armed Forces of Senegal|troops]] if the [[Economic Community of West African States]] decides to intervene militarily in [[Niger]] in response to the recent [[coup d'état]]. [https://guardian.ng/news/senegal-says-its-troops-will-join-any-ecowas-intervention-in-niger/ (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]
*[[Norway–Russia relations]]
**[[Russia]] adds [[Norway]] to its [[Unfriendly Countries List|list of "unfriendly countries"]] after Norway expelled 15 Russian [[diplomat]]s earlier this year. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-adds-norway-list-countries-unfriendly-its-diplomats-2023-08-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Cristiano Zanin]] is sworn in as a justice of the [[Supreme Federal Court]] of [[Brazil]]. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-president-lawyer-supreme-court-4dc52adaa750274bf1db5a182ac64eda (AP)]
*At least 52 people are injured and 100 others are arrested at an [[Politics of Eritrea|Eritrean pro-government]] festival in [[Stockholm]], [[Sweden]], when [[Political dissident|anti-government protesters]] storm the festival. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/08/05/world/americas-emea/52-hurt-100-detained-in-clashes-at-eritrean-stockholm-festival/1903880 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*Research shows that [[fossil]] bones of the [[Perucetus|''Perucetus colossus'' whale]] discovered in [[Peru]] could indicate that it was the heaviest animal to have ever existed. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-66384632 (BBC News)]
